title: Rigor Mortis
description:
Your flesh has set with the stiffness of the dead. Each time you take damage, you take 1 less in total.

While you are in [[Agonie]], you can give up your turn to make a Constitution + Will Roll against a DC of 20. On a success, you regain 1 HP, which ends the state, and you get back on your feet without spending movement. Either way, your turn ends.
